definitions.explanation: Used in academic, legal, and philosophical writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不可分|ふかぶん}だ。
⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不可分|ふかぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Language and culture have an inseparable relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}→経済成長：20453_keizaiseichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不可分|ふかぶん}で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Environmental issues and economic growth are inseparable, and we need to address them simultaneously.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (not) + {可|か} (possible) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (to divide). Describes things that cannot be separated or divided, whether conceptually or physically. Primarily used in formal, academic, and political discourse.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不可分|ふかぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: inseparable relationship
- {不可分|ふかぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}びついている→結びつく：13797_musubitsuku⟧: inextricably linked
- ⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧{不可分|ふかぶん}: united and indivisible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}り{離|はな}せない→切り離す：05763_kirihanasu⟧: cannot be separated (more conversational)
- ⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧な: closely connected (emphasizes closeness rather than impossibility of separation)
- ⟦{表裏一体|ひょうりいったい}→表裏一体：14082_hyouriittai⟧: two sides of the same coin (emphasizes complementary nature)
